The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Balionn-Gur]] conquered a '''planet''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and set out to rule it through law and order rather than fear. Thus, he hired diplomats to convince the populace of his intentions.
